description: The file defines the RMIExtendedSocketFactory class, a custom implementation of RMISocketFactory that creates ServerSockets bound to a specific network interface or IP address for RMI connections.

classes.name: RMIExtendedSocketFactory
classes.description: A custom RMISocketFactory that creates server sockets bound to a specific network interface or IP address.

methods.name: RMIExtendedSocketFactory
methods.description: Default constructor that binds server sockets on all interfaces.

methods.name: RMIExtendedSocketFactory
methods.description: Constructor that binds server sockets to the specified InetAddress.

methods.name: RMIExtendedSocketFactory
methods.description: Constructor that binds server sockets to the specified IP address, parsing the string to an InetAddress.

methods.name: createServerSocket
methods.description: Creates a ServerSocket bound to the specified network interface if provided, otherwise on all interfaces.

methods.name: createSocket
methods.description: Creates a standard Socket connecting to the specified host and port.
